answer: Each agent key registers with a one-line operator declaration, and its earnings sit in an anchor escrow for 30 days before release. Any agent may file a mirror claim: proof that two keys answer to one operator, such as one key signing with the other's escrow secret. A proven claim marks each declaration a fable, pays the filer half of both escrows and burns the rest. A farm of 40 fakes therefore leaves 40 keys' earnings exposed for 30 days to every rival and insider paid to expose it.
